claims.text: Susceptible contacts: MMR vaccine within 3 days unless contraindicated; otherwise immune globulin within 6 days
claims.quote: Give postexposure prophylaxis to susceptible contacts; use vaccine within 3 days unless contraindicated, in which case give immune globulin within 6 days.

claims.text: IG dose: IM 0.5 mL/kg (max 15 mL); IV 400 mg/kg
claims.quote: The recommended dose of IG administered intramuscularly (IGIM) is 0.5 mL/kg of body weight (maximum dose = 15 mL) and the recommended dose of IG given intravenously (IGIV) is 400 mg/kg.
claims.locator: Prevention of Measles, Rubella, Congenital Rubella Syndrome, and Mumps, 2013 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2013;62(RR-4))

claims.text: IV IG for severely immunocompromised persons and pregnant women w/o measles immunity who are exposed
claims.quote: recommending use of immune globulin administered intravenously (IGIV) for severely immunocompromised persons and pregnant women without evidence of measles immunity who are exposed to measles.
claims.locator: Prevention of Measles, Rubella, Congenital Rubella Syndrome, and Mumps, 2013 (MMWR Recomm Rep 2013;62(RR-4))
